title: Career Resilience Engine
subtitle: Automation Exposure Scorer + Skills Velocity Analyzer
data_vintage: Frey & Osborne (2013) Oxford Martin Working Paper — 65 SOC-keyed occupations · LinkedIn Skills on the Rise 2025 (March 2025, 15 fastest-growing US skills) · WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025 (January 2025, 10 fastest-declining skills)
regulatory_citations: Frey, C.B. & Osborne, M.A. (2013). The Future of Employment: How Susceptible are Jobs to Computerisation? Oxford Martin School Working Paper. Appendix: 702-occupation automation probability dataset (SOC 2010).
LinkedIn Economic Graph (March 2025). Skills on the Rise 2025: Fastest-growing skills by composite growth index, United States.
World Economic Forum (January 2025). Future of Jobs Report 2025. Table: Top 10 fastest-declining skills by net employer demand forecast percentage.

mcp_tool_definition.name: assess_career_resilience
mcp_tool_definition.description: Score a worker's automation exposure risk (Frey-Osborne 2013) and compute a career resilience score from LinkedIn 2025 growing skills vs. WEF 2025 declining skills. Returns two AP2-compliant mandates: automation_exposure_score and career_resilience_score.

soc_code.description: BLS SOC 2010 code (e.g. '43-9021'). Required for Tab 1 automation exposure.

occupation_title.description: Human-readable occupation title matching the AUTOMATION_RISK dataset.

growing_skills.description: List of LinkedIn 2025 Skills on the Rise that the worker has or is acquiring.

declining_skills.description: List of WEF 2025 fastest-declining skills the worker currently relies on.

role.description: Worker's current role or job title (free-text, for Tab 2 context).

industry.description: Worker's current industry (free-text, for Tab 2 context).
